notices.title: Mid-term examination timetable published
notices.body: The complete schedule for Grades 6–10 is now available on the notice board and student portal. Please review timings carefully.

notices.title: Parent–teacher meeting on 18 October
notices.body: PTM will run from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM in the main auditorium. Slots can be booked through the front office.

notices.title: Annual sports day — registrations open
notices.body: Students may register for track and field events with their class teachers until 15 October.

notices.title: Library closed for maintenance
notices.body: The central library will remain closed on 11–12 October for shelving upgrades.
